scenario: `on <pred>:` continuation fires when the response fact -- a fact of the service's response schema, `SvcReadReply` (LCRS.4.3.1) -- matches the predicate per LCCO.6.1. Simulate: assert trigger → pump (call fires) → assert `SvcReadReply` with the call's corr and `ok: true`, as the adapter would → pump → on-clause rule fires. Pin: action_log appears in the on-clause response. Path: the `on` sibling's pattern is over `SvcReadReply` on its `corr` slot (LCCO.3.3).
rules_ds:
schema SvcReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SvcReadReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min as "corr1"
        on response.ok == true:
            log info "got response"
